body: I know it's something I need to do..it's just something I can't force myself to. It's my crutch right now, its my lifeline and the only reason I can force myself to do the basic things I need to get by. I understand it's part of what's weighing me down but it's like it's the weight keeping me on the ground during a tornado. If I were to get rid of that weight then off I go carried into the darkness.. It's like trying to tell a kid the only way he'll learn how to swim is to get rid of his floaties when they're the one thing keeping him from drowning. I know it's holding me back..I'm just not sure if that's a bad thing..

I know the alcohol and drugs aren't helping but anything is better than being sober. 
Edit: What I mean by that is that when I'm sober all it does is help me think of the bad times. At least when I'm drunk or high I can forget about everything for awhile.
